summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting a material change: it entered into an arrangement agreement to acquire Vizsla Royalties Corp for total consideration of approximately C$327 million (US$239 million) on a fully diluted basis, or C$4.13 per share. Vizsla shareholders may elect to receive 0.15 Elemental shares, C$4.13 in cash, or a mix, subject to proration with a maximum cash component of C$82 million. Board of Vizsla supports the deal; officers and directors holding ~23% of Vizsla shares have entered into voting support agreements. The transaction is a court-approved plan of arrangement under British Columbia law and requires approvals from Vizsla shareholders (66 2/3% and majority excluding interested parties), stock exchanges, and Mexico's antitrust commission. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder vote timing; risk-arb spread depends on Elemental's share price movement relative to the fixed exchange ratio.
